description: cfd_3d_net_wall (fixed quasi-static wall net X 320 3 in an open-channel inflow, no floating body) with a static refined box around the net (G 1 1, G 15, G 7 0), 2 ranks: the net forces on the fluid on the patches (sixdof_void::amr_net_forces). Without them the flow went through the net unhindered (u behind the net 1.05 m/s instead of 0.87 m/s on the uniform grid of the finest cells, net force 25.0 N instead of 18.2 N).
covers: net_interface::dlm_cfd_amr on patches of two ranks
